annotations.text:
STRUCTURE: Xiaohongshu's two-column waterfall.

Fixed column width, image height drives card height, so the rows never line up — the misalignment IS the layout. Four to five posts on screen, no sections, no "why you're seeing this": the ranking is the backend's business and the UI says nothing about it.

STYLE: a printed zine, not another glossy app.

Every competitor here — Instagram, RED, Pinterest — is glossy, neutral and shadowless-clean. This is newsprint with forest-green ink and a risograph accent: paper grain over the whole sheet, and a 4px MIS-REGISTERED ink block behind every card, as if the colour plate did not quite line up. Syne for headlines, IBM Plex Mono for everything small.
Black stock is the same press, not a second theme: the inks are identical and only the paper changes. The grain screens instead of multiplying, which is what ink does on dark stock.

STILL OPEN

· Media is a duotone plate, not a photograph. Real images will fight the grain and the ink blocks — that is the thing to test first.
· Cold start: a learned feed has nothing to learn from on day one, and there is no screen for it yet.
